weightedAverageMaturityDays.rationale: No issuer-published portfolio weighted-average maturity for mF-ONE or Fasanara F-ONE. Steakhouse (2025-06-27, using end-April 2025 fund materials) discloses sleeve-level tenors (receivables duration under 90 days; consumer loans 8–12 months average) and a stale sleeve mix (39.3% receivables / 27.8% digital assets / 19.9% consumer) but no current facility-level maturity weights or a true WAM. CoinDesk/The Block confirm the multi-strategy mandate only. D3 forbids blending sleeve tenors into an unreported WAM. Searched: Midas product/docs (no mF-ONE legal-product page in docs index), Steakhouse kitchen report, CoinDesk launch coverage, SEC Form D entity page, rwa.xyz asset page.

valuationCadenceDays.rationale: Published on-chain mF-ONE/USD NAV feed (oracle 0x8D51DBC85cEef637c97D02bdaAbb5E274850e68C, description 'mF-ONE/USD', 8 decimals) shows business-day update cadence: getRoundData rounds 248–253 have successive weekday gaps of ~0.88–1.10 days (2026-07-20 through 2026-07-24 and 2026-07-27), with ~3-day weekend gaps (e.g. 2026-07-17→20, 2026-07-24→27). valuationCadenceDays=1 is the observed weekday published-NAV cadence, not a claim of independent third-party full portfolio re-marks each day (NAV path is smooth yield-like accretion). Steakhouse June 2025 text stated weekly Fasanara estimates and monthly fund-admin NAV; current chain observation supersedes that weekly claim for the published feed metric. Official fund-admin independence cadence remains single-sourced to Steakhouse and is not used as the measured metric.

creditQuality.basis: Dual-source mandate: Steakhouse Morpho onboarding report (2025-06-27, from Fasanara materials and onsite diligence) describes F-ONE as multi-strategy short-term private credit plus digital-asset market-neutral/market-making with typical leverage 1.3–1.5x; fintech lending is typically 30–80% of F-ONE via 140+ originators, SPV senior notes with originator junior first-loss, and receivables duration under 90 days; end-April 2025 mix included 39.3% receivables, 27.8% digital assets, 19.9% consumer loans. CoinDesk (2025-06-27) independently states mF-ONE tracks Fasanara F-ONE with allocations across fintech-originated receivables, SME lending, real-estate-backed credit, and delta-neutral digital strategies. Limited rather than adequate: material digital-asset and leveraged multi-strategy risk sits beside private credit; no dual-sourced current independent credit/fund rating of F-ONE itself (ARC a(f) cited by Steakhouse is for GDADF, not F-ONE); facility-level obligor tape and current weights are not public.

seniority.basis: Dual-source structure: Steakhouse §6 states mF-ONE is a MiFID II Tokenized Bearer Bond Certificate issued by Midas Software GmbH; Infinite Tokens S.A. compartment D holds a Fasanara Investments compartment AK variable funding note (F-ONE Note) as fiduciary for issuer and tokenholders, reflecting F-ONE Sub-Fund 29 of the Luxembourg SICAV-RAIF. Midas Legal Structure docs separately describe the German Issuer Setup as contractual exposure to strategy performance without Luxembourg statutory compartmentalisation (ring-fencing applies only to Lux securitisation products). Tokenholders are several layers from underlying receivables/SPV notes and lack a public senior secured claim on portfolio assets; grade limited.

legalEnforceability.basis: Dual-source identity and instrument class: Steakhouse documents German-law MiFID II bearer bond certificates under Midas Software GmbH PPM, Luxembourg RAIF sub-fund F-ONE Sub-Fund 29, and multi-entity note/fiduciary stack. Midas Legal Structure confirms German issuer products are contractual (not Lux statutory securitisation compartments) and points investors to product offering docs. SEC Form D for 'Fasanara Investments SA, SICAV-RAIF - F-One or Sub-Fund 29' corroborates the Luxembourg fund entity. Limited: public free-access final terms/PPM for mF-ONE are not listed on Midas Legal Product Documentation index (no mF-ONE product page among mAPOLLO/mHYPER/etc.); Form D is a notice filing, not prudential authorization; cross-border insolvency enforceability for the tokenised note stack is untested in the reviewed sources.

valuationCadence.basis: Dual-source published NAV process: (1) live eth_call getRoundData/latestRoundData on Midas-registered mFONE/USD oracle 0x8D51… shows business-day published updates (pinned round 253 NAV 1.11058227 at 2026-07-27T17:10:35Z); (2) Midas Smart Contracts Registry names that address as mFONE/USD Oracle, and Midas Pricing of the mToken docs describe multi-party NAV assessment with internal cross-checks and on-chain oracle tolerance. Steakhouse describes Fasanara-estimated marks feeding the on-chain price and a monthly fund-administrator official NAV (admin independence not dual-sourced product-specifically). Limited rather than adequate: no dual-sourced independent monthly attestation product-confirmed for mF-ONE; Midas Attestation Engine docs state independent onchain verification is rolling out progressively and does not yet apply to all mTokens / does not condition price updates.

maturityAndLiquidity.basis: Dual-source structural liquidity design: Steakhouse documents a three-layer stack (target ~10% mTBILL atomic sleeve, intermediate Pareto/digital sleeve, core F-ONE with monthly subscription / quarterly fund redemptions and a stated 5% of fund NAV quarterly redemption capacity), plus Midas rolling 30-day advance redemption against last published NAV and a 0.50% fee on instant-sleeve exits. Independent corroboration of product rails: Midas Smart Contracts Registry lists mF-ONE Issuance vault 0x4143… and Redemption Vault 0x44b0…; CoinDesk confirms Morpho mF-ONE/USDC repo integration for capital efficiency rather than primary full-book liquidation. Limited: primary-market liquidity is gated and sleeve-capped; full portfolio unwind is not atomic; current on-chain sleeve size and live redemption queue are not dual-sourced itemized figures in this review (Steakhouse's $0.9m atomic figure was a 2025-06-24 snapshot).

custody.basis: Dual-source multi-layer custody path without public end-to-end segregation package: Steakhouse maps (a) on-chain mTBILL/T-bill sleeve, (b) Fasanara Digital digital-asset trading with Fireblocks/Copper named for that sleeve and CEX/DeFi venues, and (c) F-ONE shares via bankruptcy-remote Luxembourg RAIF / private-credit SPV notes held through the Infinite Tokens / F-ONE Note fiduciary. Midas Legal Structure states German-issuer products do not enjoy Lux statutory compartment ring-fencing. Limited: named crypto custodians are single-report (Steakhouse); compartment cash/receivable sub-custodians and reuse/segregation terms for the full mF-ONE stack are not dual-sourced public documents.

recovery.basis: Dual-source loss path is NAV absorption without a separate tokenholder backstop: Midas Pricing docs state mTokens are not pegged or floored and NAV moves with reference-portfolio performance (can decrease). Steakhouse states credit/default and mark-to-model impairment flow through F-ONE valuation into mF-ONE price; secondary/issuer exit options include a 10% discount to last NAV and multi-layer note unwrapping rather than a funded recovery facility. No dual-sourced insurance wrap, first-loss equity tranche at the token level, or insolvency waterfall paying tokenholders ahead of other creditors was established. Limited.
